name: Happiness
q: Shared joy is doubled, shared grief halved
Full belly, warm back, that's enough
Happiness is the meaning of life
A happy person makes others happy
He is rich who is content
Happiness is made of minute fractions
Very little is needed for a happy life
The happy life is a life in harmony with nature
Happiness is not an ideal of reason, but of imagination
He who is not satisfied with a little is satisfied with nothing
Only those aiming elsewhere are happy
Man is unhappy because he doesn't know he's happy
Happiness is virtue itself, not reward
